The build-wide manifest two-way check was independently re-derived from the file tree under artefacts/M1-S01..S04 (not copied from the metadata-builder envelope's member_counts) and agrees with that envelope exactly: 34 manifest members, 34 derived members, 0 missing in either direction, with TestUserFactory correctly appearing once as a new ApexClass member.

The step's re-run cycle (documented -> running -> built -> tested) left no orphaned test artefacts: the prior run's tests/M1-S05/ captures were fully superseded by fresh captures against the current 34-member manifest, and results.json/summary.md now describe the state actually on disk rather than the state at the prior tested run.

The AuthHeader clause inside steps[M1-S05].inputs.manual_steps_the_deploy_does_not_perform (item 1) is still pre-amendment prose, unchanged since the prior test run flagged it - it reads as a single fully-resolvable manual confirmation, while artefacts/M1-S05/deploy-order.md section 3 step 1 already documents the narrower, corrected reading (grammar-parses-on-deploy plus a separate UAT confirmation) under decision D-M1S02-06 / finding PV-007. Reported again because it remains open, not because it is new.

metadata-builder's 2026-09-12T17-03-58Z re-run envelope records that the operator's brief for that re-run cited finding id S4-F-02, which does not exist anywhere in this build's records - the real finding is S2-F-11. This tester did not need to act on that citation (it only reads the resulting artefacts), but the mismatch stands as an upstream-instruction-quality signal for whoever briefs the next re-run.

The declared manual test's expected text is phrased as a checklist read rather than literal Given/When/Then, so it was checked against the testability bar (a boolean, observable outcome) rather than against Gherkin form. It clears that bar, but a human should confirm whether the shorthand 'confirming the AuthHeader formula grammar' is meant to already carry the D-M1S02-06 narrowing or is a stale summary of the original single-step framing; this agent does not resolve that judgment call.

M1-S05 is tested again after its re-run; every other M1 step remains documented from before. The doc keeper's record of M1-S05 (decisions.md, traceability.md) predates this member-count change and should be re-run to reflect 34 members before M1 is re-verified.
